title: lakik and költözik: Living and Moving

sections.title: Two verbs for a home
sections.content: lakik ("to live, to reside") is another -ik verb, conjugated the way dolgozom already taught you back in A1 — lakom, not lakok, in the "I" form. Pair it with -on/-en/-ön or -ban/-ben to say where you live. költözik ("to move house") is built the same way, and describes the move itself, not the finished state.

items.english: I currently live on the third floor.

items.spanish: Károllyal együtt költözünk egy új lakásba.
items.english: Károly and I are moving into a new apartment together.

sections.content: lakik describes where you already live, while költözik describes the act of moving itself — once the move is done, you switch back to lakik: Most már itt lakunk ("We live here now").
